title: 第一卷 第23章 夫君莫慌你的神将娘子已上线第一卷 第24章 岳父大人已上线请魏王殿下查收
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
三日后，魏王府。
晨光熹微，整座府邸却早已灯火通明，人声鼎沸。
上百人的迎亲仪仗早已整装待发，从王府门口一直延伸到长街尽头。
这些人大多面孔生疏，气质肃杀，并非王府护卫。
而是从宫里出来的禁军精锐。
每一个都气息沉稳，显然是赵道霆的亲卫。
赵辰安一身喜庆的红色王袍，跨坐在一匹神骏的白马之上。
“殿下，吉时已到。”
下人躬身上前，小声提醒。
“嗯。”
赵辰安轻应一声，随即一勒缰绳。
“出发，前往城门，迎王妃！”
“起驾！”
随着大喝，鼓乐齐鸣，浩浩荡荡的队伍开始朝着皇城南门进发。
然而，队伍行出不过半里，赵辰安就察觉到了一丝不对劲。
太安静了。
按理说，皇子迎娶稷下学宫圣女，这等轰动皇都的大事，街道两旁必然是人山人海，万民围观。
可此刻，长街之上，空空荡荡，连一个看热闹的百姓都没有。
两侧的商铺门户紧闭，窗棂之后，似乎有无数双窥探的视线，却无一人敢走上街头。
整座皇城，仿佛在一夜之间变成了一座空城。

空气中弥漫着一股压抑到极致的诡异氛围。
赵辰安却依旧神色自若，仿佛只是在进行一场寻常的郊游。
他相信，父皇既然搞出这么大的阵仗，就绝不可能没有后手。
今天只需要安安稳稳地把人接到府里，就算大功告成。
至于路上的这些魑魅魍魉，自然有父皇安排好的人去处理。
他要做的，就是看戏。
当队伍行至朱雀大街的十字路口时，前行的队伍骤然停了下来。
前方，数百名身穿稷下学宫学子服的年轻人，黑压压地堵住了整条街道。
他们手无寸铁，却一个个面带悲愤，昂首挺胸，用自己的身体组成了一道人墙。
在这些学子的最前方，还站着几位身穿朝服的官员，皆是白发苍苍的老臣。
为首的一名老臣上前一步，声若洪钟。
“魏王殿下请留步！”
“稷下学宫乃天下文枢，圣女殿下更是冰清玉洁，象征着文脉的颜面！”
“岂能屈身于王府，为一侧妃！”
“此举，是为羞辱天下读书人！”
content_en:
Three days later, Prince Wei's Mansion.
The morning light was dim, but the whole mansion was already brightly lit and full of people.
The wedding ceremony of hundreds of people was already ready to go, stretching from the entrance of the palace to the end of the long street.
Most of these people have unfamiliar faces and serious temperaments, and are not palace guards.
But the elite of the forbidden army came out of the palace.
Each of them had a calm aura, and they were obviously Zhao Daoting's personal guards.
Zhao Chenan was dressed in a festive red royal robe, sitting astride a divine white horse.
"Your Highness, the auspicious time has come."
The servant bowed forward and whispered a reminder.
"Yeah."
Zhao Chenan responded softly and then tightened the reins.
"Let's go to the city gate to welcome the princess!"
"Get started!"
With loud shouts and drums blaring, the mighty team began to march towards the south gate of the imperial city.
However, the team had only traveled half a mile when Zhao Chenan noticed something was wrong.
It's so quiet.
It stands to reason that when a prince marries a saint from the Jixia Academy, such a major event that causes a sensation in the imperial capital, there must be huge crowds of people on both sides of the street, with tens of thousands of people watching.
But at this moment, the long street was empty, not even a single person watching the excitement.
The doors of the shops on both sides were closed tightly. There seemed to be countless pairs of prying eyes behind the window lattice, but no one dared to walk onto the street.
The entire imperial city seemed to have turned into an empty city overnight.
There was a weird and extremely depressing atmosphere in the air.
Zhao Chenan still looked calm, as if he was just having an ordinary outing.
He believed that since his father had launched such a big battle, there was no way he would have no backup plan.
Today, we only need to bring people to the house safely, and we will be done.
As for these monsters and monsters on the road, naturally there will be people arranged by the emperor to deal with them.
All he wants to do is watch the show.
When the team reached the intersection of Zhuque Street, the advancing team suddenly stopped.
Ahead, hundreds of young people wearing Jixia Academy student uniforms blocked the entire street in darkness.
They were unarmed, but they all looked sad and angry, held their heads high and formed a human wall with their bodies.
In front of these students stood several officials in court uniforms, all of whom were gray-haired veterans.
The leader, an old minister, took a step forward and shouted like a bell.
"Your Highness, King Wei, please stay!"
"Jixia Academy is the hub of the world, and Her Royal Highness the Saint is pure and pure, symbolizing the face of cultural heritage!"
"How can you submit yourself to the palace and become a concubine!"
"This move is to humiliate the scholars in the world!"
